one_sentence_story: A single source artifact sends one trace through a transparent Context Capsule, where the trace becomes a torus family and cusp hexagonal fibre before returning as an explicitly provisional S6 paper claim with a visible world-trace receipt.

beats.title: Witness arrives
beats.causal_move: Place one amber source artifact on a dark hexagonal witness tile and lock its identity with a small source-pointer tab.
beats.visual: A warm paper-like artifact is the only bright object on the left; the tab uses legible words SOURCE and POINTER, not decorative pseudo-text.
beats.transition: Hold the artifact still for one second, then illuminate only its lower edge.

beats.title: Trace leaves the witness
beats.causal_move: Emit one continuous amber evidence stream from the source-pointer tab toward the center capsule.
beats.visual: The stream is a thin double ribbon with three evenly spaced particles; no second branch or dashboard panel appears.
beats.transition: The leading particle crosses the capsule boundary while the source artifact and stream tail remain visible.

beats.title: Context makes structure
beats.causal_move: Inside the transparent Context Capsule, the incoming stream resolves into a nested torus family with one cusp hexagonal fibre at the front.
beats.visual: The amber line becomes cyan at the glass boundary; three concentric torus rings rotate around a fixed vertical axis, while the hexagonal fibre pulses once at the cusp.
beats.transition: The fibre points right and pulls the stream through the capsule without changing the capsule position.

beats.title: Claim closes with a receipt
beats.causal_move: Let the fibre terminate at a white claim card that reads S6 CLAIM and PAPER CLAIM, with a separate WORLD TRACE receipt marker beneath it.
beats.visual: The card is visibly labelled as a claim and stays separate from the source artifact; the receipt marker is an outlined seal, not a fabricated metric or consensus badge.
beats.transition: The final stream segment underlines the receipt marker once, then stops.

beats.title: Falsifier remains on screen
beats.causal_move: Sweep a narrow red verification gate across the receipt marker: a missing source/world pointer reopens the claim card, while a present pointer leaves the paper claim closed but provisional.
beats.visual: Show the two outcomes as one controlled split: OPEN CLAIM on the left branch and PROVISIONAL CLAIM on the right; never show VERIFIED or CONSENSUS.
beats.transition: Return to the right branch only after the gate completes, ending with the source, capsule, torus fibre, claim, and receipt all in frame.

persistent_objects.continuity: fixed left position, amber illumination, never duplicated
one spline from source to capsule to claim; amber before capsule and cyan after boundary
fixed center position, glass edges remain readable through all beats
three rings and one cusp fibre are created once and transformed, not replaced
enters only in beat 4 and remains labelled PAPER CLAIM
outline marker only; it cannot become evidence by visual glow

caption_script: A witness does not become a claim by glowing.
The trace crosses a context boundary and takes structure.
This is an S6 paper claim, not a consensus fact.
The claim stays closed only while its source and world trace remain inspectable.

manim_plan.canvas: 16:9 landscape; camera frame 14.0 x 7.875; dark near-black background
manim_plan.determinism: Use fixed frame_rate=30, seed=11, fixed camera, fixed particle offsets [0.0, 0.33, 0.66], and no random noise or auto-layout.
shot_list: 0.0-2.0s: FadeIn source artifact, source pointer tab, and witness tile.
2.0-4.5s: Create one cubic Bezier evidence spline; animate three particles with lag_ratio=0.18.
4.5-7.0s: FadeIn capsule edges; recolor stream at boundary; Create torus rings and cusp hexagonal fibre.
7.0-9.5s: Transform fibre endpoint into claim card; Write only SOURCE, POINTER, S6 CLAIM, PAPER CLAIM, WORLD TRACE, and PROVISIONAL CLAIM.
9.5-12.0s: Sweep verification gate; use two deterministic end-state groups for OPEN CLAIM and PROVISIONAL CLAIM; hold final frame for 1.0s.
manim_plan.text_policy: All on-screen text is short, explicit, and legible at 1672x941 export; do not render filler lines, fake citations, fake measurements, or unreadable pseudo-text.

falsifier.test: Remove either the source pointer or the world-trace pointer before the verification gate.
falsifier.expected_visual_result: The claim card changes to OPEN CLAIM and the closing underline is removed.
falsifier.interpretation: The animation must not close an S6 paper claim when its trace cannot be inspected; a visual receipt is not operational evidence.
